skill_name: Write an example of a compare and contrast essay.
workflow: Cats and dogs are two of the most popular companion animals, but they have distinct differences. Cats prefer to be solitary and independent while dogs thrive on being with people and prefer to be social. Cats like to sit on laps and be pet, but they lack the enthusiasm that dogs show when in need of affection.
